entities.summary: Robert White Creeley was an American poet and author of more than 60 books. He is associated with the Black Mountain poets, although his verse aesthetic diverged from that school. Creeley was close with Charles Olson, Robert Duncan, Allen Ginsberg, John Wieners and Ed Dorn. Robert Creeley was a writers & intellectuals from Arlington (1926-05-21, Arlington–2005-03-30). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
